title: [AINews] Math Proofs Are Landing Faster Than We Can Read Them
author: swyx .ai
description: November 25, 2026 — From Erdős problems to new bounds for matrix multiplication and Fourier transforms.
summary: AINews by Latent Space Scott Aaronson was still trying to digest two proofs of VP ≠ VNP at dinner. Before dessert, an OpenAI paper claimed that the square matrix multiplication exponent ω is exactly 9/4 .
takeaways: Google Cogentic : Six papers were posted to GitHub without an announcement, produced by an agent harness on unnamed Gemini 4 models ( @AndrewCurran_ ; details ).
Before dessert, an OpenAI paper claimed that the square matrix multiplication exponent ω is exactly 9/4 .
The big releases underline how much a paper count can hide.
